People just, uh, can't be nice.|"[[The Radio]]"}} '''Critics''' are a group of deceased characters {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== These "critics" were various people who disliked the fiddle music played by [[Carl (TV series)|DJ Carl]] on the [[KPSS radio station]] and attempted to make him change his repertoire or silence his station altogether.[[Thaddeus]]: ''"Great job on these booby traps, by the way. Really good."''
[[Carl (TV series)|DJ Carl]]: ''"Hey, thanks."''
Thaddeus: ''"Yeah. That one's crazy."''
DJ Carl: ''"Critics."''
Thaddeus: ''"Yeah. People just, uh, can't be nice."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) To prevent this, Carl has booby-trapped the station's building extensively, and the area is now littered with the remains of numerous critics. ==In the TV series== ===[[The Radio]]=== The critics' corpses and skeletons can be seen scattered around the traps outside the KPSS radio station. When [[Maximus]] decides to let [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] leave with [[Siggi Wilzig]]'s head, he disfigures the severed head of one of Carl's critics to use it as a decoy. When Lucy and Maximus kiss, the lips of the two heads they hold also touch. ===[[The Beginning]]=== Maximus brings the critic's head to the [[Knights of San Fernando]] in [[Filly]], claiming it to be Wilzig's head, but it's quickly discovered by the [[cleric]]s to be a decoy. ==Appearances== The critics appear only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|7=107|8=108}} ==Gallery== FOTV KPSS Closeup with Thaddy.png|[[Thaddeus]] among the bodies caught in Carl's booby traps ("[[The Radio]]") FOTV1-7 critic1.jpg|Decapitated critic corpse FOTV1-7 critic2.jpg|Critic corpses in background FOTV1-7 critic3.jpg|"Kissing" Decoy head scanned.png|The decoy head being scanned ("[[The Beginning]]") ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
